title: After 660 hours of solo development, my dream RPG is finally playable! 🥹⚔️
author: Curious-Size7752
selftext:
**Play FREE in your browser** \- no download needed!

[https://mightygladiators.itch.io/mighty-gladiators](https://mightygladiators.itch.io/mighty-gladiators)

In the DEMO: 14 waves, 2 brutal bosses, 4 heroes, and lots of character upgrades!

This is the **single-player alpha demo**. Co-op is coming next!

I'd genuinely love to hear what you think. Every bit of feedback means a lot to me!

Thank you for giving my little project a chance! 

  
threejs + Blender + Astra + Tripo + AccuRig

comments.author: topsykerretts
comments.body: Have you considered expanding from just arenas to hallway (dungeon) like levels?

replies.author: Curious-Size7752
replies.body: Yeah, I have lots of ideas for what else I could do with it, but this arena alone took me a crazy amount of work, and I'd like to release the whole game on Steam as is. If anyone is even interested in the game, I'd definitely like to keep expanding it as much as my time allows.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Curious-Size7752 this post needs more detail on how you used AI in development, so please add some. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process, not only the finished game. We're trying to keep "check out my game" posts from taking over the sub. If you don't update, this may be removed.

replies.author: Curious-Size7752
replies.body: The characters have many abilities and talents, and the game offers many items with various abilities and effects. The game features many bonus missions and events. It took a lot of time to develop the co-op mode, including many different PvP modes. The game currently has four unique bosses, each with unique cooperative mechanics, and the constant adjustments and optimizations took an enormous amount of time.
